Source: ~/.copilot/logs/process-1787504072726-3249010.log line 32 (Copilot CLI 1.0.80, captured 2026-08-23T16:54:33.735Z)

2026-08-23T16:54:33.735Z [ERROR] Invalid hook configuration in /home/pascal/.copilot/hooks/s5-probe.json: hooks: hooks must be an object

Trigger: ~/.copilot/hooks/s5-probe.json was first written with the bare shape
  { "sessionStart": [...], "SessionEnd": [...] }
On 1.0.80 this is rejected (logged, silently skipped, no crash). The file-based
hooks-dir schema requires a "hooks" wrapper object:
  { "hooks": { "sessionStart": [...], "SessionEnd": [...] } }
Rewriting the probe file with the "hooks" wrapper made both entries fire (see
payload.sessionStart.user-hooks-dir.camelCase.json and
payload.SessionEnd.user-hooks-dir.claude-compat-alias.json in this directory,
captured moments later in the same log file).
